armboth_ranger.text: You're the new leaseholder? Thank you, truly. Enclosure Ltd had this down as 'a forestry asset'. I always thought it was a wood.
Take your time. A forest isn't a thing you fix. It's a thing you stop interrupting.

then.text: Rows of spruce as far as you can see and not a bird in them. It's like a car park, but for trees.
We've thinned the rows and put in oak, rowan and birch along the becks. It looks a bit scruffy. That's the point.
Red squirrels are using the new trees, and I've seen a kite over the ride. A KITE, in the Lakes. I rang my mother.

else.text: Mixed wood, open rides, an osprey on the tarn. The timber company would call it unproductive. I'd call it the best wood in Cumbria.

armboth_forester.text: Sitka grows to harvest in about forty years. An oak takes three hundred. You can see why the accountants picked the Sitka.
Don't lean on the stacked logs. I say that to everyone. About one in ten leans anyway.
